name: Fine-tuning graders — score_model judge
summary: POST /v1/fine_tuning/alpha/graders/validate and /run take a nested `grader.model` (a judge LLM, e.g. `o4-mini-2025-04-16`) used during RFT training and grader validation.
description: The reinforcement fine-tuning (RFT) grader endpoints accept a `score_model` grader whose `grader.model` names a separate judge LLM constrained to a specific supported list. This is a second BYOM candidate `model` slot inside the fine-tuning surface (the first being the base model on `POST /v1/fine_tuning/jobs`, which is already known to be non-BYOM-routable and tracked in the `byom-incompatible-endpoints` rollup). Whether the grader's judge model honors a `{connection}/{deployment}` prefix is untested.
notes: Status-only. Fine-tuning itself is winding down per OpenAI, so this card mostly documents completeness of the `model` inventory rather than a live workstream.
